name: GRPO scale protocol implementation amendment 1
reason: The first scale launch emitted a decoder-only right-padding warning during policy generation. Right padding can make batched continuations condition on padding rather than the final prompt token.

implementation_change.before: GRPOTrainer constructed its processing tokenizer implicitly
implementation_change.after: The policy tokenizer is constructed explicitly with padding_side=left and passed as GRPOTrainer.processing_class
implementation_change.scope: policy prompt batching and generation only

prospective_status.audit_validity: Policy-relative audits already used src/eval_grpo_pilot.py, whose tokenizer explicitly uses left padding. The frozen predictions and their hash remain unchanged.

artifact_isolation: Corrected training writes to grpo_scale_v2 so that partial outputs from the invalid launch remain separate.
